name: literal_arithmetic_and_precedence
query: SELECT DISTINCT 1 + 2 * 3 AS a, (1 + 2) * 3 AS b, -(3) AS c, 7 - 10 AS d, 7 / 2 AS e, 10 / 0 AS f, 2.5 * 2 AS g, year - 2000 AS yy WHERE account = 'Expenses:Financial:Fees' ORDER BY yy
notes: int op int stays int except /, which always yields a decimal (7 / 2 = 3.5). Division by zero yields NULL instead of an error.
